message.content: Elegant wool-blend midi coat in midnight blue (#0a1e35), tailored fit reaching mid-calf with a structured lapel, accented by subtle silver threading. Silk-crepe slip dress in champagne gold (#f7e7ce), empire waist cut for a fluid silhouette, falling to just above the knee with a V-neckline. Pointed-toe leather pumps in forest green (#1a3c2d), moderate heel height for comfort and polish. Delicate pendant necklace in oxidized silver (#8a8a90) and faux-fur stole in charcoal gray (#364045) to soften the coat's edge. This ensemble balances festive warmth with refined sophistication, using rich jewel tones against neutral skin undertones to create depth without overwhelming the celebratory mood. The structured outer layer respects the frosty weather while the fluid inner layers maintain an effortless, modern elegance suitable for a New Year's restaurant gathering.
